title: Truth Knows No Language: Evaluating Truthfulness Beyond English

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and comparing the truthfulness and informativeness of Large Language Models across five different languages (English, Basque, Catalan, Galician, and Spanish) using multiple-choice metrics, LLM-as-a-Judge, and human evaluation on a translated version of the TruthfulQA benchmark.

Comparing the evaluation scores assigned by LLM-as-a-Judge models from different families (e.g., Llama 3.1 and Gemma 2) to check if they exhibit preferential scoring patterns when evaluating responses generated by models from their own family versus other families.
